# incremental-compute-cache

> Memoised function graph with a persistent cache invalidated by code and input hashes, recomputing only the dependents of what changed Python package `trysac-incremental-compute-cache`, import name `incremental_compute_cache`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
